readme.excerpt:
Quick start · Gallery · What it makes · Install · Usage · Examples · How it works · Limits

Ask Claude for a figure that explains a technical idea, and Anatomy has it invent a physical thing whose working is the concept. A cache key that skips work when nothing changed becomes a pin-tumbler lock that only turns when every pin matches. One GPU context serving many canvases becomes a gantry plotter whose single print head visits 16 wells.

Then Claude builds that thing out of dozens of small, solid, shaded parts, puts it in a framed card with a title, a hint and a live readout, makes it move calmly under the pointer and the keyboard, and checks its own work by zooming in on every joint. Every number the figure shows comes from the same small model that moves its parts.

items.name: poki
items.description: Let AI agents operate a real iPhone. Local MCP server and agent, no jailbreak, no extra hardware.

readme.excerpt:
Install Poki on my iPhone from https://github.com/JosssphZhou/poki

The agent follows the install-poki skill and runs bin/install-iphone.mjs , which does every step it can by itself. You only do what iOS asks of you: type your Apple Account into a Poki Setup window on the Mac, tap Trust and turn on Developer Mode on the iPhone, trust the developer, and open Poki. When Poki first opens it asks for Automation Mode: tap Continue and enter the iPhone passcode. If you cancel, turn Poki on again to be asked again. The agent tells you each one in a sentence when it comes up. A free Apple Account works.

Requires macOS 14+, Node.js 24+, iOS 18+, a USB data cable, an Apple Account, and a compatible VPN/proxy app on the iPhone that routes 10.7.0.1 back to it, such as Karing or Shadowrocket configured through Poki's Setup instructions. On iOS 27 and later Poki controls the iPhone through its native services by default. On iOS 18 to 26 it uses the XCTest session instead, as Alpha 0.2.9 did; this release was not tested on a physical iPhone below iOS 27. Xcode is not required. Free Apple Account signing lasts 7 days and needs renewal. Enable UI Automation in the iPhone's Developer settings and configure model access in Poki. With an older Poki Setup and no Xcode, the agent asks you to finish model-key and connection setup manually and reports those checks as unverified until you confirm them.

readme.excerpt:
A flight simulator for platform engineers: a real Kubernetes platform on your laptop, broken on purpose, with your fix graded.

SnowOps Labs is a Kubernetes platform-engineering simulator. One command builds a production-shaped cluster on your laptop: real Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, Argo CD, Istio, Kafka and Vault, not mocks. Then it breaks that cluster in ways you will meet on call, and grades how you fix it against the live cluster.

Practise what production never lets you practise: finding why every pod is Ready while a third of requests fail, draining a node under load without breaking the SLO, or picking a service mesh with evidence instead of opinion. It runs on macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel), Linux and Windows via WSL2, or in your browser through GitHub Codespaces.

readme.excerpt:
A daily snapshot of the DACH AI/data-job market: 3,000+ live postings from 1,200+ employers across Germany, Austria and Switzerland. Every day at 08:00 UTC+2 a Databricks pipeline queries the Adzuna API for 18 AI/data related job titles in all three countries, deduplicates and classifies the results through a bronze/silver/gold Delta Lake. It then gets scanned against a curated 71-term skills dictionary and published to a static GitHub Page.

- See the shape of the market - volumes by role, city and country, how long postings stay open, seniority mix, tool mentions and many more. - Read the postings behind any number. Every chart is a count of real postings, and those postings are browsable: search by title or employer, filter by role, country, city and seniority, sort by newest or longest-open. - Watch it move. Nothing is ever overwritten, so each run adds to the record and every figure gains a second dimension: not just how many AI roles are open, but whether that number is climbing or declining.

Full songs with an editable score, generated on your own GPU. One executable — no Python, no Node.js, no launcher.

YuE2 Studio is a desktop studio for YuE2 , the open song model from M-A-P that writes a score before it sings. Describe a style, write the lyrics, and the model composes a melody with chords as sheet music, then performs it as a full song with vocals. The score comes back with the track: read it, edit it, and render the same composition again with a different sound. Windows installer with auto-update or a portable folder, runs offline on an NVIDIA card with 6 GB of VRAM or more; AMD and Intel cards through Vulkan are experimental.

It is built on yue2.cpp, the native C++/CUDA port of YuE2. The studio around it is Rust and React in a Tauri window — nothing in the runtime path is Python.
